invariants.name: pinned_actions_integrity
invariants.description: All GitHub Actions must use full 40-character SHA hashes
invariants.enforcement: stack_gate.py verifies no @vN tags in workflow files

invariants.name: sha256_verification
invariants.description: All build artifacts must have SHA256 checksums
invariants.enforcement: kernel_build_gate.py validates checksums exist and match

invariants.name: single_slot_execution
invariants.description: Installation sequence must target Slot A only
invariants.enforcement: INSTALL-SEQUENCE.md and rollout_gate.sh enforce Slot A

invariants.name: kernel_commit_locked
invariants.description: Kernel source must be built from pinned LineageOS commit

invariants.name: gki_compliance
invariants.description: Kernel must be built with GKI-compliant config

invariants.name: patch_application_order
invariants.description: DroidSpaces patches must be applied before KernelSU and SUSFS
invariants.enforcement: apply_patches.sh applies patches in defined order

invariants.name: no_binary_commit
invariants.description: No modified binaries in repository root

invariants.name: provenance_transparency
invariants.description: All builds must generate attestation records

invariants.name: secretless_operation
invariants.description: Pipeline must work without PATs on public forks
invariants.enforcement: No secrets required for checkout/build steps

invariants.name: gpl_compliance
invariants.description: Modified kernel sources must be published with binaries
invariants.enforcement: Release artifacts include SOURCE.tar.gz with kernel sources

invariants.name: config_fragment_integration
invariants.description: Device config must be merged with GKI base defconfig

invariants.name: susfs_version
invariants.description: SUSFS module must be R28 or compatible

invariants.name: rom_version_tag
invariants.description: ROM builds must be tagged with Evolution X 11.11

invariants.name: candidate_validation
invariants.description: Kernel candidates must pass fixture certification

metadata.description: 21-layer build stack specification for Nothing Phone 2 kernel/ROM CI/CD
